item.title: Bulletin updated at 21:00 HKT 11/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China for the rest of this week and early next week. It will be hot with a few showers over the region. Besides, the southwesterly airstream will become active in the latter part of this week. There will be more showers with squally thunderstorms and it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 12/06 (Wednesday)
Wind: Southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. More showers in the morning. Hot with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
